items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Mezz Mezzrow used to mail to Louie, through the mail every where we went, marijuana.

ctx.x: And, you know, back in those days, it was not illegal to smoke pot. I mean, we -- we smoked pot all over the bandstand, and so, I asked Louie, I said, "Louie, what we gonna do with this, man?" He says, "We're gonna smoke a little bit of it every day, and then we're gonna have Mezz for dessert. Now, Mezz Mezzrow used to mail to Louie, through the mail every where we went, marijuana. And --
